title: Total tensor commutes with the open-site equivalence
statement: Let X be a scheme and U an open [def-pc-scheme]. Let A,K be arbitrary cochain complexes of modules on the over-U site. Let T be the degreewise functor of Modules.overEquiv U. There is an isomorphism T(Tot(A tensor K)) to Tot(T(A) tensor T(K)), where each total tensor is the actual coproduct total complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. No acyclicity, boundedness, K-flatness, or evaluation map is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the proved exists_localizedOpen_tensor_equivalence to the two terms in each bidegree. Naturality with an identity in one variable gives compatibility with each differential; HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents twice constructs the bicomplex isomorphism.

The equivalence is additive and preserves all coproducts. Compose the inverse of HomologicalComplex₂.mapTotalIso with HomologicalComplex₂.total.mapIso of the bicomplex comparison. Totalization incorporates the signs, so this is the displayed chain isomorphism. These are applications of the proved totalization interfaces; no boundedness or homological property is used.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_totalTensor_overEquiv_iso (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (A K : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ) :
    let L := Equivalence.functor
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)
    let T := L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    Nonempty (T.obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor A K (curriedTensor _)) ≅
      CochainComplex.mapBifunctor (T.obj A) (T.obj K) (curriedTensor _))
